items.text:
Ok first off before I state anything and before you buy this game understand one thing it's in alpha, not beta or released this is the bare bones of this game now with that said

this game is amazing right now yes its got the bugs the most annoying currently being the fact that if you leave a game you can't re-enter it unless you close the game and reopen however that's to be expected with a alpha build now as of currently the price is $20 and well that's quiet high for a alpha build game its current status and complexity is insane and has me worried about what its gonna look like and play like in the later versions as this is as of right now not an easy game by any standpoint and you should damn well expect to fail many many times before you get a good start as finding what you need is souly based on RnG and getting lucky with a decent ship cluster however there is still promise and i do enjoy how the start of the game works as depending on how you set up items and your character you can either be good at getting one thing or the other now currently there are a few things that can be changed first of the RCS use and control in docking is stupid finicky you can go towards the arrow only to super speed past the docking port then go back the same amount and never see it until its to late and you hit the ship so that needs to be worked on with sensitivity seconds the save system needs to be worked on third the current way that repairs are done is off and there honestly should be a damage hud to show you whats damage what has O2 what is getting O2 and where power connectors are not were they are powering forth there is currently no combat system that i know of besides what look to be interceptor ships that do not follow you and finally the most annoying the orbit ring BS so when you spawn in you are put into a random system i believe its currently preset for alpha purposes however the station at the center has a orbit ring aka the green ring that is its path of orbit around a star well this piece of ♥♥♥♥ ring has a collision box so when docking it is so stupidly common to clip either into the thing or dock into the ring then get fired into space when you undock and that needs to be change maybe by adding a planet or star deeper in by like i dont know 1/4 an INCH also the current way that navigation works needs some fixing currently if you place a target anywhere but a set item like a ship yourself another NPC ship or a station it flys off to the left and if you have target tracking takes your ass with it also I don't know if it's a bug or an intended feature but if you have target tracking set to on and you exit the nav console it takes you to the center of a random solar system and you have to zoom back out then find your system and zoom back in

now I will play this game more and update this review as I go incase I find anything more or if anything changes also feel free to comment if anything I stated was wrong or I missed something.
items.text_zh:
好吧，首先在我陈述任何事情之前，在你购买这款游戏之前，要明白一件事：它处于alpha阶段，不是beta也不是已发布，这是这款游戏目前的骨架，话虽如此

这款游戏现在就很棒，是的，它有bug，目前最烦人的是，如果你离开一个游戏，你就无法重新进入，除非你关闭游戏再重新打开，不过对于alpha版本来说这是意料之中的，目前价格是20美元，对于一款alpha版本的游戏来说这相当高，它目前的状态和复杂度简直疯狂，让我担心它在后续版本中会是什么样子、玩起来会怎样，因为就目前而言，从任何角度来看这都不是一款简单的游戏，你完全应该预料到在获得一个好的开局之前会失败很多很多次，因为找到你需要的东西完全基于随机数生成，以及运气好遇到一个不错的飞船集群，不过仍然有希望，我确实喜欢游戏开局的方式，因为根据你如何设置物品和你的角色，你可以擅长获取某样东西或另一样东西，目前有几件事可以改，首先是RCS的使用和对接中的控制蠢得令人抓狂，你可以朝着箭头前进，结果却以超高速冲过对接端口，然后以同样的量往回走，直到为时已晚才看到它，然后撞上飞船，所以这需要针对灵敏度进行处理，其次存档系统需要改进，第三目前进行维修的方式不对劲，老实说应该有一个伤害HUD来显示什么受损了、什么有氧气、什么正在获得氧气，以及电源连接器不在它们正在供电的地方，第四据我所知目前没有战斗系统，除了那些看起来像拦截舰的飞船，它们不会跟随你，最后最烦人的是轨道环的破事，所以当你生成时，你被放入一个随机星系，我相信目前为了alpha目的它是预设的，然而中心的太空站有一个轨道环，也就是那个绿色环，那是它围绕恒星运行的轨道路径，好吧，这个♥♥♥环有一个碰撞箱，所以对接时极其常见地会卡进那东西里，或者对接进环里，然后当你脱离对接时被弹射到太空中，这需要改变，也许可以通过在更深处添加一个行星或恒星，比如我不知道，四分之一英寸，另外目前的导航工作方式也需要一些修复，目前如果你把目标放在任何地方，除了一个固定物品，比如一艘飞船、你自己、另一艘NPC飞船或一个太空站，它会向左飞走，如果你开启了目标追踪，它会把你的屁股也一起带走，另外我不知道这是一个bug还是一个有意设计的功能，但如果你把目标追踪设置为开启，然后退出导航控制台，它会把你带到某个随机太阳系的中心，你必须缩小视图，然后找到你的星系，再放大回去

现在我会更多地玩这款游戏，并随着进展更新这篇评测，以防我发现更多东西或者有什么变化，另外如果我说的有什么不对或者我漏掉了什么，欢迎评论。
